notes.title: 10.22 New Galaxy War play mode & Guild System
notes.content:
l	COMPLETELY NEW GAMEMODE: GALAXY WAR!
l	Controls: LMB to drag view, RMB to move Fleet
l	Fleet: Battles will drain both fleets’ total weight. Using Alloy to increase total weight and allocate more ships into battle
l	Resources: Planets generate resources over time. Resource is gathered when moving past a planet. Gold is consumed relative to total weight when moing
l	Guild System: Enemy guild players are red, self guild players are blue. Battles are initated when contact with enemy ships. Players can create guilds.

l	The original Ammo&Fuel system is canceled.
l	Massively optimized weapons
l	Buffed the weapon distance for the following: Machine Gun, Torpedo, Missile, Mortar, Laser, Boomerang
l	Buffed defense units’ energy limit
l	Nerfed Black Hole Launcher’s effect
l	Halved Armor’s weight and effect
l	Nanocables will only connect to ships with nanocables
l	Landmine exploding by time expiring will also damage
l	Magnet effects are now team colored
l	Projectiles shot by AA will explode instead of falling

l	Currency can be bought with diamonds

l	Fixed some weapons can shoot while holding R in multiplayer
l	Fixed textboxs not displaying completely


星系地图玩法：
1.操作
(1)右键点击移动舰队
(2)左键拖动视图
2.舰队
(1)战斗会消耗双方的吨位
(2)花费合金提高舰队吨位可以在战斗中使用更多的飞船
3.资源
(1)星球上定期产生金币和合金资源，经过星球时自动采集资源
(2)移动时根据舰队总吨位持续消耗金币
4.公会
(1)同一公会的玩家名字是蓝色,敌对公会玩家名字是红色
(2)接触到敌对公会的玩家时发生战斗(对方的舰队吨位需要大于一定范围)
(3)玩家可以创建军团，团长可以编辑军团头像。

屏蔽体力值，使用大地图资源控制游戏时长
大幅度优化武器射击效率
提高大部分武器的射程：机枪，鱼雷，导弹，迫击炮，激光，回旋镖
提高防御类设备能量
削弱黑洞引力
护甲防御力和重量减半
纳米线改为只和有纳米线的飞船连接提高可操作性
地雷超时引爆后也可以伤害附近敌人
磁铁的线根据队伍区分颜色
防空炮击落子弹效果改为爆炸

商店中增加金币和合金的购买
好友列表扩容到20
部分武器射击时按R可以连续射击bugfix
文本输入框文字会截断bugfix

notes.title: 7.7 Update, introducing the new Fleet Battle!
notes.content:
New gamemode: Fleet battle!
Each side has a core to protect. By sending your fleet with in-game energy, you must destroy the core to win. Energy is consumed relative to ship weight, and is regenerated through time and from destroying ships.

新武器：自动枪：自动射击近身的敌人
新的防空炮模型
